summary: Seagate Technology Holdings plc filed an 8-K announcing the closing of privately negotiated exchange agreements with holders of its subsidiary's 3.50% Exchangeable Senior Notes due 2028. Under the exchanges, $185.908 million principal amount of notes was exchanged for $185.908 million in cash plus 2,023,124 ordinary shares of Seagate. The share count was determined over one trading day beginning May 21, 2026. The exchanges closed on May 26-27, 2026. This debt-for-equity swap reduces leverage and dilutes shareholders. No board recommendation or external advisors were disclosed. Watch for potential further liability management or impact on credit ratings.
